q01.question: ¿Qué fármacos con target HER2 (gen ERBB2) se prueban en ensayos de fase 3 (incluye fase 2/3) de cáncer de mama?

attempts.query:
WITH her2 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(md.parent_chembl_id, md.chembl_id) AS parent_id
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol = 'ERBB2'
),
names AS (
  SELECT h.parent_id, lower(md.pref_name) AS nm
  FROM her2 h
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON COALESCE(md.parent_chembl_id, md.chembl_id) = h.parent_id
  WHERE md.pref_name IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT h.parent_id, lower(s.synonyms)
  FROM her2 h
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON COALESCE(md.parent_chembl_id, md.chembl_id) = h.parent_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_synonyms s ON s.chembl_id = md.chembl_id
  WHERE s.synonyms IS NOT NULL
),
trials AS (
  SELECT s.nct_id
  FROM aact.studies s
  WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3', 'PHASE2/PHASE3')
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions bc
      WHERE bc.nct_id = s.nct_id AND bc.downcase_mesh_term = 'breast neoplasms'
    )
),
iv AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS txt
  FROM aact.interventions i JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = i.nct_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name)
  FROM aact.intervention_other_names o JOIN trials t ON t.nct_id = o.nct_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.pref_name
FROM names n
JOIN iv ON iv.txt ~ ('(^|[^a-z0-9])' || regexp_replace(n.nm, '([.^$*+?()\[\]{}|\\-])', '\\\1', 'g') || '($|[^a-z0-9])')
JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary p ON p.chembl_id = n.parent_id
WHERE length(n.nm) >= 4
  AND p.pref_name IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

q13.question: ¿Cuántos ensayos de cáncer de próstata prueban algún fármaco aprobado que actúa sobre el receptor de andrógenos (gen AR)?

attempts.query:
WITH ar_parents AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(md.parent_chembl_id, dm.parent_chembl_id, dm.chembl_id) AS parent_id
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  LEFT JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary md ON md.chembl_id = dm.chembl_id
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol = 'AR'
),
approved AS (
  SELECT ap.parent_id
  FROM ar_parents ap
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary p ON p.chembl_id = ap.parent_id
  WHERE p.max_phase = 4
),
mols AS (
  SELECT md.chembl_id
  FROM chembl.molecule_dictionary md
  JOIN approved a ON a.parent_id = COALESCE(md.parent_chembl_id, md.chembl_id) OR a.parent_id = md.chembl_id
),
drug_names AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT lower(trim(n)) AS name FROM (
    SELECT md.pref_name AS n FROM chembl.molecule_dictionary md JOIN mols m ON m.chembl_id = md.chembl_id
    UNION
    SELECT ms.synonyms FROM chembl.molecule_synonyms ms JOIN mols m ON m.chembl_id = ms.chembl_id
  ) x
  WHERE n IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(n)) >= 4
),
prostate AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT nct_id FROM aact.browse_conditions
  WHERE downcase_mesh_term = 'prostatic neoplasms'
),
trial_texts AS (
  SELECT nct_id, lower(name) AS txt FROM aact.interventions WHERE intervention_type IN ('DRUG','BIOLOGICAL','COMBINATION_PRODUCT','OTHER') OR intervention_type IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT ion.nct_id, lower(ion.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names ion
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.nct_id) AS n
